tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere — warm paper by day, 'night chai' brown by night. Never pure white.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, top bar, tab bar, inputs. Sits on `paper` with `elev-1`.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: stock-bar track, skeleton base, table header, pressed ghost buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons on `paper`, `paper-raised`, `paper-sunk`, `clay-100`, `marigold-100` (≥11:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary label (the second language), captions, helper text on `paper`, `paper-raised`, `paper-sunk` (≥5.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and placeholder only — deliberately below 4.5:1; never for information.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and cards. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, chip and outline-button borders on `paper` / `paper-raised` / `paper-sunk` (≥3:1).

tokens.name: clay-100
tokens.usage: Primary tint: selected chip, active tab pill, sidebar active row, secondary button fill.

tokens.name: clay-500
tokens.usage: Primary button hover (web). White/`on-clay` text still ≥4.5:1.

tokens.name: clay-600
tokens.usage: THE brand terracotta (mitti). Primary button fill, logo house, focus of attention. One primary action per screen.

tokens.name: clay-700
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed fill (colour shift that goes with the 2px sink).

tokens.name: clay-800
tokens.usage: The tactile 'lip' under primary buttons (`btn-lip`) and the logo's shadow tone.

tokens.name: clay-ink
tokens.usage: Terracotta as text: links, active tab label, on `clay-100` (≥6.4:1) and `paper`.

tokens.name: on-clay
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `clay-500/600/700` fills (light ≥4.6:1, dark ≥5:1).

tokens.name: marigold-400
tokens.usage: Genda-phool accent: logo capsule half, illustration highlights, AI-badge icon. Never text, never a status.

tokens.name: marigold-100
tokens.usage: Warm highlight wash: AI-suggestion card and badge background, onboarding tips.

tokens.name: leaf-400
tokens.usage: Tulsi-leaf green for illustration and the 'family' chart series only. Not the resolved status.

tokens.name: leaf-100
tokens.usage: Soft leaf wash behind illustrations on success moments.

tokens.name: status-out
tokens.usage: Out of stock / missed — text + icon on `status-out-bg` (≥6.1:1) and `paper`.

tokens.name: status-out-bg
tokens.usage: Out-of-stock chip, row and banner ground.

tokens.name: status-out-solid
tokens.usage: Out-of-stock bar fill and chart marker (≥3:1 on `paper-sunk`).

tokens.name: status-low
tokens.usage: Running low — text + icon on `status-low-bg` (≥6.3:1) and `paper`.

tokens.name: status-low-bg
tokens.usage: Running-low chip, row and banner ground.

tokens.name: status-low-solid
tokens.usage: Running-low stock-bar fill (≥3:1 on `paper-sunk`).

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Resolved / delivered / in stock — a teal-leaning green so it never pairs with red by hue alone. Text + icon on `status-ok-bg` (≥5.9:1).

tokens.name: status-ok-bg
tokens.usage: Resolved chip, success toast and row ground.

tokens.name: status-ok-solid
tokens.usage: Healthy stock-bar fill, chart 'ok' marker (≥3.5:1 on `paper-sunk`).

tokens.name: status-wait
tokens.usage: Waiting / pending — text + icon on `status-wait-bg` (≥5.8:1).

tokens.name: status-wait-bg
tokens.usage: Waiting chip and offline banner ground.

tokens.name: status-wait-solid
tokens.usage: Waiting step dot in the case stepper; unknown-stock bar.

tokens.name: chart-need
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 — medicine NEED (demand). Same as `clay-600`.

tokens.name: chart-stock
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 — STOCK on hand (cocoa).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (marigold-dark), e.g. forecast.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (leaf), e.g. delivered.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axis ticks. Decorative.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with a 2px `paper` gap — ink, so it clears 3:1 on every surface incl. `clay-600`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind bottom sheets, profile menu on mobile, dialogs.

families.display: "Baloo 2", "Baloo 2 Devanagari", "IBM Plex Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Devanagari", system-ui, sans-serif
families.hindi: "IBM Plex Sans Devanagari", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: m-display
styles.usage: Welcome / success headline. Max one per screen.
styles.sample: आपकी दवा आ गई · Your medicine is here

styles.name: m-title
styles.usage: Screen title in the top bar area.

styles.name: m-body-lg
styles.usage: DEFAULT body on patient & ASHA screens.

styles.name: m-body
styles.usage: Default body on pharmacist screens; secondary paragraphs.

styles.name: m-label
styles.usage: Primary-language line of a button / tab / row.

styles.name: m-label-2nd
styles.usage: Second-language line under a label (ink-muted). Never smaller than 14px.

styles.name: m-caption
styles.sample: 2 दिन पहले अपडेट · updated 2 days ago

styles.name: m-number
styles.usage: Big counts (tablets left, days left). Tabular figures.

styles.name: d-body-sm
styles.usage: Dense body, table cells, secondary line.

styles.name: d-label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav items, table headers (sentence case).

styles.name: d-caption
styles.usage: Axis labels, metadata. Minimum size on web.

styles.name: d-data
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and charts — tabular, right-aligned.

spacing.note: 8-pt system with a 4px half-step. Names are the pixel value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: icon-to-text inside chips, stacked bilingual label gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Base unit. Gap inside buttons, between chips.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Card inner gap between rows of text; list row vertical padding (with 56px min height).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Mobile screen side margin and 4-col gutter; card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Card padding on web; gap between cards on mobile; web grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section gap on mobile; web card grid gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Section gap on web; hero internal spacing.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Top of empty states; large vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-56
tokens.usage: Min tap target on mobile (buttons, rows, tab items).

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Web top bar height; bottom tab bar height (with safe area).

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Web page side margin at 1440 (12-col).

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Landing-page section rhythm.

radius.note: Friendly, rounded, never sharp. Buttons 16, cards 22.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Status chips' inner icon plate, table row highlight, checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, data-age badge, inputs on web, stock-bar ends.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons (all sizes), mobile inputs, toasts, list tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, banners, bottom tab bar, sidebar active pill container.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, hero cards, app-icon corner at 1024 (scaled), illustration frames.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, toggle, mic FAB, language pill, dot indicators.

shadow.note: Soft, warm-tinted (brown, never grey-black) elevation. Buttons use a 'lip' shadow for tactile depth.

tokens.name: elev-0
tokens.usage: Flat: rows inside a card, table cells.

tokens.name: elev-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards, inputs, tab bar, top bar.

tokens.name: elev-2
tokens.usage: Hovered card (web), chips raised, dropdowns, profile menu.

tokens.name: elev-3
tokens.usage: Toasts, bottom sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: btn-lip
tokens.usage: Primary button at rest: a 4px clay-800 lip + warm glow = the 'clay tile' you want to press.

tokens.name: btn-lip-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary pressed: lip shrinks to 1px while the button moves down 3px.

tokens.name: btn-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary / tonal button and big tile buttons at rest.

tokens.name: btn-soft-pressed
tokens.usage: Secondary pressed.

tokens.name: inset-well
tokens.usage: Stock-bar track, focused input well, toggle track.

tokens.name: tap-mobile
tokens.usage: Minimum height/width of anything tappable on patient, ASHA and pharmacist mobile screens.

tokens.name: tap-mobile-hero
tokens.usage: The one hero action (mic 'बोलकर बताएँ', 'Hand over medicine').

tokens.name: tap-web
tokens.usage: Minimum control height on district web; 40px only inside dense tables.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips and table cells.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon (buttons, tabs, rows). 2px stroke.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Tile buttons, empty-state lead icon, mic FAB.

tokens.name: topbar-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile top bar height.

tokens.name: tabbar-mobile
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height (icon + two-line bilingual label).

tokens.name: sidebar-web
tokens.usage: Web sidebar width (collapses to 80px rail at < 1200px).

tokens.name: topbar-web
tokens.usage: Web top bar height.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the 12-col content area at 1440 (80px margins).

tokens.name: grid-mobile-cols
tokens.usage: Mobile: 4 columns at 360px.

tokens.name: grid-mobile-margin
tokens.usage: Mobile side margin.

tokens.name: grid-mobile-gutter
tokens.usage: Mobile gutter → column = 72px at 360.

tokens.name: grid-web-cols
tokens.usage: Web: 12 columns at 1440px.

tokens.name: grid-web-margin
tokens.usage: Web side margin at 1440 (sidebar sits outside the grid: grid starts after 264px sidebar with 40px margin).

tokens.name: grid-web-gutter
tokens.usage: Web gutter → column = 84px at 1280 content.
